items.text: Adults 21 and over may buy at licensed dispensaries and possess up to 6 ounces of cannabis and cannabis products. Public consumption isn't allowed; use on private property unless the owner restricts it, or in licensed consumption areas attached to dispensaries (21+, no alcohol or tobacco).
